TI BQ27411/BQ27541 fuel gauge

Required properties:
- compatible: must be "ti,bq27541-battery"
- reg: I2C slave address

Optional properties:
- qcom,modify-soc-smooth: update the BQ27411 SOC-smoothing parameters

Example:

	bq27541-battery@55 {
		compatible = "ti,bq27541-battery";
		reg = <0x55>;
		qcom,modify-soc-smooth;
	};
